info.title: SentinelPay Fraud Detection API
info.description:
Real-time fraud detection and prevention REST API. Implements the Transaction ingestion pipeline (FR-01–FR-08), Fraud Case management (FR-09–FR-10), and ML Model lifecycle (FR-13–FR-14) from the SentinelPay System Requirements Document.

**Author:** Teboho Mokoni  
**Assignment:** 12 – Service Layer and REST API  
**Stack:** Python 3.12 · FastAPI · In-memory repositories (A11)

post.summary: Submit a transaction for fraud evaluation
post.description: Accepts a transaction from the Payment Processor, validates the schema (FR-02), tokenises PII (BR-T2), and persists the transaction ready for ML scoring.

get.description: Returns all persisted transactions. Supports optional filtering by decision or risk_tier.

schema.title: Response Get All Transactions Api Transactions Get

get.description: FR-09: Returns all HARD_BLOCK transactions for the fraud case generation pipeline.

schema.title: Response Get Flagged Transactions Api Transactions Flagged Get

post.summary: Apply fraud decision to a transaction
post.description: FR-07: Applies ML ensemble model scores, computes the composite fraud_score, and produces a FraudDecision (APPROVE / SOFT_DECLINE / HARD_BLOCK) using per-account-tier thresholds.
FR-09: Creates a fraud case for a HARD_BLOCK transaction with HIGH or CRITICAL risk tier. Priority is automatically derived: P1 (≥0.90), P2 (≥0.75), P3 (<0.75). Enforces one case per transaction_id.

201.description: Case created and added to analyst queue

409.description: Case already exists for this transaction

422.description: Risk tier must be HIGH or CRITICAL (FR-09)

get.description: Returns all fraud cases. Filter by status or priority using query parameters.

schema.title: Response Get All Cases Api Fraud Cases Get

get.description: FR-10: Returns all OPEN and IN_REVIEW cases sorted by priority (P1 first). SLA breach status is included in each case response.

schema.title: Response Get Analyst Queue Api Fraud Cases Queue Get

get.summary: Get a fraud case by ID

delete.description: CONFIRMED cases cannot be deleted — they feed the retraining pipeline.

patch.summary: Assign a case to a fraud analyst
patch.description: FR-10: Assigns an OPEN case to a named analyst. Moves case status from OPEN → IN_REVIEW.

409.description: Case is not in OPEN state

patch.description: FR-10: Resolves a case as CONFIRMED or DISMISSED. CONFIRMED publishes a fraud label to the MLOps retraining pipeline (BR-FC3). DISMISSED requires a non-empty analyst note (BR-FC2).

200.description: Case resolved; fraud_label_payload present if CONFIRMED

409.description: Case must be IN_REVIEW to resolve

post.summary: Register a new ML model version
post.description: FR-13: Registers a new model version in TRAINING stage. model_name must be one of: XGBOOST, ISOLATION_FOREST, DISTILBERT. Model ID is auto-generated as '{model_name_lower}-{version}'.

get.description: Returns all model versions. Filter by stage or model_name using query parameters.

schema.title: Response Get All Models Api Ml Models Get

get.description: FR-14: Returns all models currently in PRODUCTION stage. Polled every 60 seconds by the Model Loader for hot-swap detection.

schema.title: Response Get Production Models Api Ml Models Production Get

delete.description: PRODUCTION models cannot be deleted. Promote a replacement first.

post.summary: Record evaluation metrics for a model
post.description: FR-13: Records precision, recall, F1, and AUC-ROC from holdout-set evaluation. Returns meets_promotion_gate: true/false indicating readiness for PRODUCTION promotion. Gate: precision ≥ 0.85 AND recall ≥ 0.80 (BR-ML1).

409.description: Model not in TRAINING or STAGING stage

patch.summary: Promote a model to the next lifecycle stage
patch.description: FR-13: Advances the model through TRAINING → STAGING → PRODUCTION → ARCHIVED. Promoting to PRODUCTION enforces BR-ML1 (precision ≥ 0.85 AND recall ≥ 0.80). Existing PRODUCTION model of the same type is automatically ARCHIVED (FR-13).
FR-14: Reloads the model artifact for a PRODUCTION model without service restart. Only callable on PRODUCTION-stage models.

409.description: Model must be in PRODUCTION stage

get.description: Returns 200 OK when the API is running.

ApplyDecisionRequest.title: ApplyDecisionRequest
ApplyDecisionRequest.description: POST /api/transactions/{id}/decision — apply ML ensemble scores and produce FraudDecision.

AssignAnalystRequest.title: AssignAnalystRequest
AssignAnalystRequest.description: PATCH /api/fraud-cases/{id}/assign — assign case to a fraud analyst.

CreateFraudCaseRequest.title: CreateFraudCaseRequest
CreateFraudCaseRequest.description: POST /api/fraud-cases — create a fraud investigation case.

HotSwapRequest.title: HotSwapRequest
HotSwapRequest.description: PATCH /api/ml-models/{id}/hot-swap — reload artifact in PRODUCTION without restart.

target_stage.title: Target Stage
target_stage.description: One of: STAGING, PRODUCTION, ARCHIVED, REJECTED

PromoteModelRequest.title: PromoteModelRequest
PromoteModelRequest.description: PATCH /api/ml-models/{id}/promote — advance model through lifecycle stages.

RegisterModelRequest.title: RegisterModelRequest
RegisterModelRequest.description: POST /api/ml-models — register a new model version.

note.title: Note
note.example: Velocity fraud pattern confirmed via geo analysis.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: One of: CNP_ONLINE, CNP_MOBILE, POS, ATM

SubmitTransactionRequest.title: SubmitTransactionRequest
SubmitTransactionRequest.description: POST /api/transactions — submit a new transaction for fraud evaluation.

TransactionResponse.title: TransactionResponse
TransactionResponse.description: Response schema for Transaction — safe to return (no raw PII).

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Submit transactions, apply ML ensemble fraud decisions, and query the transaction store. Maps to FR-01 through FR-08.

tags.name: Fraud Cases
tags.description: Manage fraud investigation cases. Create cases for HARD_BLOCK transactions, assign to analysts, resolve with CONFIRMED/DISMISSED. Maps to FR-09 and FR-10.

tags.name: ML Models
tags.description: Register, evaluate, and promote ML model versions through the TRAINING → STAGING → PRODUCTION lifecycle. Hot-swap artifacts without service restart. Maps to FR-13 and FR-14.
